player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Turnu {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Turni Vincuti - Cumannanti Alpha: {alpha_score}, Cumannanti Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formatu d'intrata non validu. Utilizà: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Nomu di campu nvalidu (s). Campi validi: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Tutti li attribuzzioni hannu a èssiri nteri nun nigativi.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Hai a allocari esattamenti {num_total_units} unitati. Suma currenti: {current_sum}

outcome.draw: Lu jocu si conclude n tie {score_0}-{score_1} doppu {num_rounds} turni!
